strings.presenter.welcome.caption: Hi! I'm Tito! Move the mouse or use the arrow keys to swim, and press the space bar to leap out of the water! Collect all the pearls!
strings.curiosity.delfino.breaching.caption: Dolphins leap out of the water, up to four metres high! They do it to play and to show faraway friends where they are.
strings.curiosity.delfino.echolocation.caption: The dolphin makes little clicks: listening to the echoes, it finds fish even where it cannot see!
strings.curiosity.delfino.blowhole.caption: A dolphin is not a fish: it is a mammal! It breathes air through the hole on top of its head, the blowhole.
strings.curiosity.delfino.pods.caption: Dolphins live in families called pods: together they herd fish and keep each other safe.
strings.curiosity.delfino.teeth.caption: A dolphin has many tiny teeth, but it never chews: it grabs the fish and swallows it whole!
strings.curiosity.delfino.whistle.caption: Every dolphin has its own special whistle, almost like a name: that is how friends recognise it!
